content: मण्डूकः [मण्डयति वर्षासमयं, मण्ड् ऊकण् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 42</ls>] .²1 A frog; निपानमिव मण्डूकाः सोद्योगं नरमायान्ति विवशाः सर्वसंपदः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a particular breed of horses. .²3 A machine like a frog. .²4 The sole of a horseʼs hoof. .{@-कम्@} A kind of coitus or mode of sexual enjoyment. .{@-की@} .²1 A female frog. .²2 A wanton or unchaste woman. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of several plants.
